Recipients — no AI drafting

Open a draft per recipient

    
Write it once (or paste your finished email, images included). Each selected recipient gets their own separate draft, addressed only to them. {{first_name}} and {{name}} are filled in per person.

    

    

      
      

        
        
        
        
        
        
      

      

    

    

      
      
      
    

    

      How the mail-app button works: your browser downloads one small .eml file per recipient and your mail app opens each as an unsent draft with the images embedded — review, hit Send. To have them pop open automatically: after the first download, click the arrow next to it in Chrome's downloads and choose Always open files of this type. (You may need to allow multiple downloads once.) The text-only option is a plain mailto: link — no images or formatting.

OdooLink

            
Quick Reference Guide · v15.32

          

          v15.32
        


        
        

          
⚙ Setup & Connection

          

            
Required servers:

            

              python imap_server.py  → port 7843

              python server.py       → port 7842
            

            
Double-click start.bat to launch both and open the app.

            
Settings tab: Enter Odoo URL, database, username, API key, and Groq API key. Use Export/Import credentials to back up and restore all settings, templates, and specs.

            
Groq model: qwen/qwen3.8-27b by default. Change in Settings if hitting rate limits.

          

        


        
        

          
🔍 Search (top nav)

          

            
Click the search icon in the top bar and type what you need to do — it instantly matches against every section below, or ✦ Ask AI for a natural-language recommendation if nothing obvious matches (needs a Groq key).

            
3+ characters also live-searches Odoo contacts and orders directly — jump to a customer, ✉ Compose, 📝 Note, 📅 Activity, or 🧾 Quote them without leaving the search box.

          

        


        
Daily


        
        

          
✉ Inbox

          

            
Unified inbox for Turbify/IMAP, Odoo messages, and Gmail. Click any row to expand the body — invisible tracking characters and HTML noise are automatically stripped.

            
✦ Draft — AI reply draft using Groq. 📋 Log — fetches body, opens note modal with live Odoo contact search override. 📅 — schedule activity. 🗑 — move to Trash (IMAP only).

            
Bounce emails: Delivery failures auto-detect the undeliverable address and pre-fill the contact search in the log note modal.

          

        


        
        

          
📥 Lead Capture

          

            
Scans IMAP inbox for inbound leads matching your specs. AI extracts contact name, phone, email, and notes.

            
Forwarded emails: Auto-detected (Fwd: subject). AI extracts the real customer from the forwarded body, not the internal forwarder. Card shows ⟳ Forwarded badge.

            
Contact override: In the Review modal, search Odoo contacts by name or email to link the lead to an existing contact instead of creating a new one.

            
Push to Odoo: Creates crm.lead + res.partner + chatter note + follow-up activity in one click.

          

        


        
        

          
⚡ Activities

          

            
Scans due Odoo activities and AI-drafts a follow-up email per contact using deal context and last chatter note. "Catching up on activities for" defaults to you, but you can pick any rep on your team — switching it re-scans for that person without a full reconnect. "Draft how many" caps the batch (oldest overdue first) so a rep with a huge backlog doesn't force one long run — the scan log tells you the true total so you know whether to raise it. A Stop button appears while drafting is in progress and keeps whatever's already been drafted.

            
Send tab: checkboxes on every card plus a bulk toolbar up top — Select all, a live count, and a bulk log button. Per card: Review & edit (full modal — actually opens your mail client and logs) · ✉ Draft email (Quick Compose via IMAP) · 📋 Log (bulk or one at a time) · Skip (excludes it from bulk actions).

            
Log options (Send tab): logging always posts the note. Mark original activity done, Schedule a follow-up and Tag customer are independent — e.g. clear the activity with no follow-up, or tag only. Uncheck both activity boxes when catching up someone else's activities and their activity stays scheduled exactly as is, with the drafted email waiting as a note.

            
Skip drafting — collect recipients: on the Connect tab, skips the AI entirely and opens the Recipients tab with every due activity's email address (duplicates merged, missing emails listed). From there: 📋 copy the addresses, ⬇ CSV, → Move to Mass Mail, or write/paste one email (images supported; {{first_name}} is filled per person) and Open drafts in mail app to get one separate unsent draft per recipient. Then I sent them applies what you choose: clear the activity, log a note, schedule a follow-up (off by default), and tag the customer. Nothing in Odoo changes until you press it.

            
📄 Export report downloads a standalone HTML file of the selected drafts — no login or Odoo connection needed to open it. Each entry shows contact, subject, and body in a click-to-select box, ready to hand to a rep who copies each one into their own email. 📋 Copy as text puts a plain-text version straight on your clipboard instead, for pasting directly into an email body. Both respect the current selection, same as the log buttons.

            
🔍 Verify on a card shows the raw, unfiltered chatter messages actually on that Odoo record — useful for confirming whether a note genuinely posted when something seems off.

            
Follow-up Tracker: Shows leads pushed from Lead Capture that have no scheduled activity. Requires Odoo connection.

          

        



        
Quoting


        
        

          
📝 Request Desk

          

            
Paste any vague quote request — AI extracts contact info and drafts a TRSAV-style response with clarifying questions (event date, venue, indoor/outdoor, audience size, AV needs, budget).

            
Custom AI prompt: Click "Customize AI response prompt" to edit and save your own. Blank = TRSAV default.

            
Actions: Send email · ⬆ Push to Odoo (contact + opportunity + logged draft) · Schedule activity · 📋 Log to contact · Copy.

          

        


        
        

          
✦ Smart Builder

          

            
The AI-first sibling of Request Desk — paste a raw request (email, text, voicemail transcript) and AI extracts customer, dates, venue, and equipment, then auto-builds the quote for you. Fastest path from a raw ask to a built quote.

            
Use Request Desk when you'd rather build the equipment list yourself; use Smart Builder when you want AI to take the first pass.

          

        


        
        

          
🧾 Quotes

          

            
The Rental Quotation Builder — creates the order directly in Odoo as a rental (is_rental_order + per-line pickup/return dates), with Odoo's own rental rules calculating pricing.

            
Search/pick a contact (shows open opportunities and last contact date), set pickup/return dates, then add equipment via ⊞ Browse catalog, an Odoo quote template, or a saved local template (My templates).

            
Create deep-links straight to the new order in Odoo's Rentals app.

          

        


        
        

          
📋 Templates

          

            
Left panel: saved template card list. Right panel: editor + AI Composer.

            
Editor: Name, keywords (auto-suggest triggers), body with clickable variable insertion ({{customer_name}}, {{subject}}, {{date}}, {{my_name}}, {{sender_email}}).

            
AI Composer: Describe purpose + tone → Groq returns name, keywords, and body. Available in Quick Compose, Activities drafts, Dormant Contacts.

            
Build from inbox email: Wizard pulls real inbox emails to build templates from actual conversations.

          

        


        
Pipeline


        
        

          
🔭 Prospecting

          

            
Target-criteria search (industry, niche) to find brand-new prospect companies you haven't worked with yet.

            
Net-new business — distinct from Dormant Contacts (existing accounts gone quiet) and Sales Targeting (mining your own sales history).

          

        


        
        

          
💤 Dormant Contacts

          

            
Finds contacts and open opportunities with no scheduled activity and no recent movement. Filters: days inactive, type (customer/supplier/all), rep, exclude tag.

            
Search: Name, company, or internal reference # (Odoo ref field).

            
AI re-engagement draft · Send via IMAP with auto-log · Bulk schedule activity on all selected.

          

        


        
        

          
🏭 Vendor Outreach

          

            
Search Odoo vendors or use 🔍 Find vendors to open YellowPages/Yelp/Google pre-filled. Paste results → AI extracts contacts into cards.

            
Pending section (gold border): extracted vendors not yet in Odoo. ⬆ Push to Odoo per card or Push all.

            
Per vendor: ✉ Mail (opens your default mail app, prefills their email if known) · Send (internal compose) · Blast quote requests to all selected.

          

        


        
        

          
🎨 Email Studio

          

            
The master marketing email, ready to edit. Open a section on the left to change the text, links, buttons and pictures (Upload / replace crops and shrinks a photo to fit, or paste a hosted image URL). Untick show to drop a section, add or reorder feature cards, switch Dark / Light, or override the brand and accent colours.

            
Save as new… keeps your version as a reusable template (stored in this browser; Export / Import a file to back it up or move it to another computer). Your work-in-progress is autosaved as a draft. ↺ Master returns to the original design.

            
Copy for Outlook then Ctrl+V into a new message; Copy HTML is for Mailchimp / HubSpot. Pair it with Mass Mail to send to a list and log it in Odoo.

          

        


        
        

          
📨 Mass Mail

          

            
Upload an Excel/CSV contact list (needs a name column and an email column). Pick a batch size in increments of 5 up to 75 per batch — Outlook can't reliably take more than that through a single send.

            
Copy recipient list pastes cleanly into Outlook's To/CC/BCC field (default BCC) — more reliable than "Open in Outlook" for full-size batches.

            
After you've actually sent it, click "I sent it — log to Odoo & schedule follow-up." It looks up each recipient by email, posts a note on their contact, and schedules a follow-up activity for whichever rep you assign.

          

        


        
Work & Comms


        
        

          
🗂 Projects & Tasks

          

            
Projects tab: Card grid of all Odoo projects. Click a project to view its tasks, or + New project to create one.

            
Tasks tab: Filter by project, assignee, stage. Quick-add bar at top. Checkbox moves task to Done in Odoo — not deleted, can be reopened.

            
To Do tab: Personal tasks, local first, push to Odoo with ⬆.

            
✦ AI Brainstorm tab: Conversational — describe a goal, AI asks questions before generating tasks. Save as Task · To Do · New project.

          

        


        
        

          
💬 Discuss

          

            
Quick Message tool — send a message to an Odoo colleague or log a note directly to a lead/contact without leaving the app.

          

        


        
        

          
🛠 Support

          

            
Remote Support launchers — Quick Assist, Windows RDP, AnyDesk, TeamViewer — or send a client a session invite link.

          

        


        
Utilities


        
        

          
📭 Bounce Manager

          

            
Upload .txt or .csv of undeliverable emails, or paste them. Fuzzy-matches against Odoo contacts — exact email first, then local-part matching.

            
Per card: 📋 Log note to chatter · ✕ Clear activities · 📅 Reschedule · Bulk log all matched at once.

          

        


        
        

          
💳 Expenses

          

            
Employee Expenses pulls expense reports from Odoo. Filter by employee, status, and month. Each row shows receipts and, when it's awaiting approval, ✓ Approve / ✕ Refuse buttons that act directly on the Odoo record — refuse asks for a reason first.

            
Vendor Bills (second tab) pulls from Accounting/Invoicing — every bill a vendor has sent in, filterable by vendor, status, payment state, and month. Draft bills get a ✓ Validate & Post button; attachments open the same way as expense receipts.

            
Both views total whatever's currently filtered — Spend by Category for expenses, Spend by Vendor for bills.

          

        


        
        

          
🏦 Reconciliation

          

            
Needs Coding lists every unreconciled bank / credit card line (or any line with no partner) as a sortable, searchable table. For each one the tool suggests a partner and account learned from lines you already reconciled (up to 18 months), with a confidence and a one-line reason: Confident = one of your rules, or at least 3 past lines and 80%+ agreement; Likely = fewer or less consistent examples, worth a glance; Guess = no history yet, so the account is matched by keyword (airline, tolls, software…) to your chart of accounts — pre-filled but never ticked; Review = nothing to go on or mixed history. ✨ Suggest with AI (needs your Groq key) asks for an account for Review/Guess rows, sending merchant names and account names only — no amounts. If everything says Review, the grey banner above the table says how much history was found and why. Confident rows start ticked; ✓ Accept all Confident saves just those after a confirm. Use ✎ to change a partner or account by hand. A ⚠ flags lines where the partner Odoo picked disagrees with your history (use it swaps it). Payments that settled invoices are ignored when learning. Nothing is written until you save, and lines you save become history for next time.

            
Coding rules (collapsed above the table) still work — "description contains X → this partner, this account" — and always outrank history.

            
Check for Deviations scans already-coded transactions, groups them by vendor, and flags any transaction coded to a different account than that vendor's usual one. Nothing changes automatically — review the flagged list and approve a fix per-item or in a batch.

            
This is genuinely new ground for OEL — bank reconciliation is one of the more version-sensitive parts of Odoo's accounting model, so if a save or fix comes back with an error, that detail is worth passing along; it means something about this Odoo instance's setup differs from what the tool expects.

          

        


        
        

          
📨 Invoice Follow-up

          

            
Lists every open (unpaid/partial) customer invoice with a clear status badge — Never sent, or Sent N× · last X days ago. That status comes from a note this tool posts to the invoice's Odoo chatter every time you send or mark one — nothing is tracked only on this device, so it holds up across browsers and logins.

            
Hit ✉ Send to open a composer pre-filled from one of three templates — First Notice, Follow-up, Final Notice — auto-suggested based on send history and days overdue, fully editable before sending. The customer's Odoo portal payment link is fetched and inserted into the body automatically when available.

            
Send & mark as sent opens your mail client with the subject/body ready and logs the send in one step. Mark as sent only is there for when you sent it some other way and just need the tracking updated.

            
Payment matching. Each load also pulls your unreconciled bank deposits and compares them to the open invoices. A 💳 line appears under an invoice when a deposit is the exact amount, or the amount after Stripe fees (default 2.9% + $0.30 for cards, 0.8% capped at $5 for ACH — editable under “Payment matching”), or one deposit covers several invoices for the same customer. The Probably Paid card and the “Probably paid” filter list them in one click, and sending a reminder for one asks you to confirm first. Nothing is written to Odoo — it only points you at the deposit so you can reconcile it there.

            
Unreconciled bank deposits (bottom of the tab) lists every deposit with its best-guess invoice. For one with no suggestion — say Stripe batched several customers into one payout — hit Match…, tick the invoices, and the calculator shows the expected net after fees against the deposit. Find a batch searches combinations of 2–3 open invoices for you.

            
Use the Sort menu to order by due date, most overdue, payment found first, amount, customer, or never-sent first.

          

        


        
        

          
⤓ Export & Print

          

            
The Export button in the top bar works on every tab: Print / Save as PDF produces a clean, light, one-column version of whatever is on screen (no sidebar or buttons) — use it instead of screenshots — and Excel / CSV download the tables you're looking at (one sheet per table).

            
Sales Reporting, the Accounting summary on the Reports tab, Invoice Follow-up and Reconciliation also have their own ⤓ Export / Print button that exports just that block with the filters currently applied.

          

        


        
        

          
📑 Financial Reports

          

            
Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, P&L, Aged Payable, and Aged Receivable — computed from your posted ledger entries (account.move.line + account.account), not pulled from Odoo's report engine directly — that isn't reachable through the API this app uses. The output is verified to match Odoo's own default report layout exactly: same rows, same section hierarchy, same bold/indent formatting, checked cell-by-cell against real exports from this instance.

            
Trial Balance and P&L total activity within the chosen period. Balance Sheet and both aging reports are a snapshot as of the end date — that's standard accounting practice, not a bug if the start date looks unused there. The Balance Sheet includes a self-check (Assets = Liabilities + Equity) and flags a warning if it doesn't tie out.

            
Check any reports you need, set the date range, and Download Selected — each downloads as its own XLSX file, ready to hand to whatever else reviews your books.

          

        


        
        

          
📋 Cover Shortages

          

            
Search for a rental or sales order by number or customer, select it, and its line items load as your starting list. Adjust each quantity down to your actual shortage, remove anything you've got covered, search to add a catalog product that isn't on the order, or use + Add a custom line for anything that isn't in Odoo's product catalog at all — just a description and quantity.

            
Two speeds, same vendor checklist: ✉ Quick ask opens one email BCC'd to everyone checked — nothing is created in Odoo, it's just casting the net before you know who you're going with. Create formal RFQ(s) makes a real draft RFQ (Odoo's purchase.order in draft state) per vendor checked — use it once you've picked who you're actually asking, even if that's still more than one for comparison. Est. cost per line is optional either way — leave it blank to let the vendor quote.

            
No vendor list showing? It's filtering Odoo contacts by supplier_rank > 0 — the same field Vendor Outreach sets when it creates one. If the fetch itself fails (a network hiccup), you'll now see the real error with a Retry button rather than just an empty list. Don't see the vendor you need at all? + Add a vendor to Odoo creates a real contact on the spot. For a true one-off you don't want in Odoo yet, use the one-off email field instead — it only feeds Quick ask, never creates a record, and can stand in on its own with no vendor checked at all.

            
Open RFQs tracks everything still in RFQ status. ✉ Send opens an editable composer and marks it sent; ✓ Confirm → PO converts it into a real Purchase Order once the vendor's agreed to the order — same Odoo record, just a state change, nothing new to re-enter.

          

        


        
        

          
🎯 Sales Targeting

          

            
Load a QuickBooks "Sales by Customer by Quarter" pivot export (.xlsx/.csv) to build a rep target list for the quarter.

            
Filter by year, quarter, minimum spend, and recency — including Lapsed (12+ or 20+ quarters with no order) to surface who needs a call.

            
→ Move to Data Explorer: sends the current filtered list straight into Data Explorer's matching/activity pipeline in memory — no export or re-upload needed.

          

        


        
        

          
🔎 Data Explorer

          

            
Upload any spreadsheet (or receive one directly from Sales Targeting), pick which columns matter, and it scans Odoo to match each row — Exact / Partial / New.

            
Bulk actions: assign a rep + due date to checked rows · 📅 Schedule checked (creates Odoo activities in bulk) · ⚠ Create & Link checked (for companies not yet in Odoo).

            
Export XLSX or Print report from the same toolbar.

          

        


        
        

          
📄 Documents

          

            
Local document library — W9s, COIs, contracts. Attach any file to an Odoo contact whenever you need it.

          

        


        
Reports


        
        

          
📊 Reports

          

            
Dashboard: 8 CRM cards + 4 accounting cards, click any for drill-down. ⚡ Daily Briefing opens a picker: tick the sections you want (My day, Sales, Accounting, Emails, Operations) and get a live company-wide report plus an optional AI summary. Quick reports: Aged AR · Top Customers (YTD) · Overdue Notices — print-ready.

            
Sales Reporting: filter rental/sales orders by rep, order type, stage, and delivery month, sortable on every column. Commission estimate toggle restricts to confirmed orders, switches to delivery-date filtering, and totals goods-only revenue by product category (not product type) — use ⚙ Categories to mark which categories count as services, and the rate chips (5% / 7% / 10% / custom) to set the payout percentage. The delivery-date field auto-detects from your Odoo schema and can be overridden in the dropdown if it guesses wrong.

            
Location shows the order's delivery/shipping address. Tax isn't pulled from Odoo's tax engine — it's whichever order line has "tax" in its name, shown by name and amount so you can tell NW Tax from Local Tax at a glance. Use ⚙ Tax names to maintain the approved list — any tax line that doesn't match gets flagged in red with a ⚠, and the "Unapproved Tax" summary card counts how many orders need a look.

          

        


        
        

          
🔧 Troubleshooting

          

            
App not updating after deploy: Updates now load automatically (HTML is fetched network-first). If a stale copy persists, hard refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R. Service worker cache key = odoolink-app-v15.32.

            
Odoo calls failing: Confirm server.py is running on port 7842. Check status lights in Settings. All domains must be flat arrays for Odoo 19 — no nested | operators. The header Connect button retries automatically (up to 3x) since the public CORS proxies it cycles through in Proxy mode can be individually flaky — "retry 1/2" in the status text is normal, not an error. If it still fails after retries, switch to Local Server mode in Settings.

            
IMAP not working: Confirm imap_server.py is running on port 7843. Gmail requires an App Password. Turbify uses standard IMAP credentials.

            
AI drafts failing: Check Groq API key in Settings. Verify model name — default is qwen/qwen3.8-27b.

            
Credentials lost: Use Export Credentials to save a JSON backup. Import on any device.
